rows.jyutping: daai3 zyu6 fung3 ci3 ji3 mei6 gam3
rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken way to describe a sarcastic or ironic tone.

example.traditional: 佢帶住諷刺意味咁話：「你真係好準時喎。」
example.jyutping: keoi5 daai3 zyu6 fung3 ci3 ji3 mei6 gam3 waa6 nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 zeon2 si4 wo3

rows.note: Use this for a wry facial expression, especially when someone smiles despite discomfort or resignation.

example.english: They looked at me wryly and said they were fine.
example.traditional: 佢帶住苦笑咁望住我，話自己冇事。
example.jyutping: keoi5 daai3 zyu6 fu2 siu3 gam3 mong6 zyu6 ngo5 waa6 zi6 gei2 mou5 si6
